# Caffeine Dose | Alfred Workflow
Keeps your Mac awake using the `caffeinate` command-line utility. Start or stop sessions, set a duration or end time, and check status.
## Usage
Start typing your action in Alfred using your configured keyword (default: `caff` or `cfs`, or your preferred trigger).
### Toggle Caffeinate (`caff`) Toggle caffeinate on or off to prevent macOS from sleeping.
- **Keyword:** `caff` (default or your preferred trigger) - Hold Command (⌘) to allow display sleep.
### Set Duration or Time (`cfs`) Set caffeinate for a specific duration or until a specific time. Also shows if caffeinate is active or inactive. Supports natural input for minutes, hours, and times.
- **Keyword:** `cfs [duration or time]` (default or your preferred trigger) - Hold Command (⌘) to allow display sleep.
**Examples:** - `cfs s` — Shows status, time left, and if display can sleep. - `cfs d` — Deactivates caffeinate. - `cfs i` — Keeps your Mac awake indefinitely. - `cfs 15` — Keeps your Mac awake for 15 minutes. - `cfs 2h` — Keeps your Mac awake for 2 hours. - `cfs 1 30` — Keeps your Mac awake for 1 hour and 30 minutes. - `cfs 8am` — Keeps your Mac awake until 8:00 AM. - `cfs 9:30` — Keeps your Mac awake until the next 9:30. - `cfs 11:40pm` — Keeps your Mac awake until 11:40 PM.
Supports both 12-hour (AM/PM) and 24-hour time formats.
### Customization
- **Keywords:** Customize `caff` and `cfs` in workflow settings. - **Time format:** Set to 12-hour (AM/PM) or 24-hour in workflow settings. - **Hotkeys:** Set hotkeys for quick and direct actions, like toggling caffeinate or starting a session instantly.
